messages.subject: AMATA | Smart industrial cities, investor relations and government stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Kromadit and AMATA Leadership Team,

AMATA's focus on smart industrial cities, cross-border expansion and sustainable growth creates a strong fit with my experience working where international investment, government, communities and large-scale industrial operations meet.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities cover government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy. I routinely align ministries, regulators, operating teams and strategic partners around investment and operational priorities.

My recent work includes stakeholder and governance support around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, carbon-data readiness, and multi-agency regulatory coordination. I bring a practical understanding of the institutional conditions needed for industrial investment to progress while maintaining environmental and community confidence.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand, Vietnam or wider regional mandates across Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or Country Strategy. I have attached an AMATA-focused executive CV and would appreciate your sharing it with Mr. Vikrom Kromadit and the relevant leadership team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
